title: Absorb g copies of the heavy slice by the factor-10 gate (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

The `g` copies of the heavy slice fit the factor-10 gate. For integers `p ≥ 2`, `g ≥ 1`, `K ≥ 0` and `C ≥ 0`, whenever `p ≥ max(64, 4K + 2C)` and `10 g ceil(log2 p) ≤ p`, `g` copies of

```text
(p^{10})^{g-1} p^6 (1 + p^4) exp(K p - p^2)
```

are strictly below `2^{-C p}`. The gate forces `g < 2^L`, so the copies add one `L`. For `p ≥ 64`, `8 L ≤ p`, and eight times the exponent is at most `9 p + 8 - 4 p^2`. The polynomial `4 p^2 - 9 p - 16` equals `15792` at `p = 64` and increases by `8 p - 5`, so the exponent is at most `-C p - 1`.

At `p = 256` and `g = 3`, `10 g L = 240 ≤ 256` while `16 g L = 384 > 256`, and the copies exponent is `-65287`. The published coefficient-9 gate remains `16 g L ≤ p`. At `p = 2` and `g = 2` the hypothesis fails. Since `e < 3`, two copies are larger than `1`.

A factor smaller than `10` stays open. The trailing bound `p^{10}`, the section error, and the ceiling `9 p^2` stay hypotheses. This package does not prove `||H^{-1}||_2 ≤ p^{10}`. No new κ. The selected record remains `23/10000`. This answers the open question of #4527. It branches from fetched main and does not replay that unmerged package.

## Test plan

- [x] Prints `PASS_GAUSSIAN_SLICE_TEN_COPIES` and `outcome=completed`
- [ ] Maintainer replay was not run

Base `f9f85c1e4fa1e955ff39f10fca447e3e2a4e4adc`, priority revision 7. Upstream fetched at 2026-10-22T03:46:25Z was that commit. The pre-submit fetch, reread at 2026-10-22T03:48:02Z, was unchanged, and the four pinned blobs match. κ remains `23/10000`.
